statement: At least one merchant vessel is struck by a projectile, drone, mine or explosive in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf or Gulf of Oman between 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-21.
resolution: YES if UKMTO reports a merchant vessel struck by a projectile, drone, mine or explosive in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf or Gulf of Oman between 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-21; NO otherwise.
failure_condition: No merchant vessel is struck by a projectile, drone, mine or explosive in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf or Gulf of Oman between 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-21.

statement: A merchant vessel is struck by an aerial or naval drone or a missile inside the Bulgarian or Romanian Black Sea exclusive economic zone between 2026-10-08 and 2026-11-06.
resolution: YES if the Bulgarian or Romanian government, or Reuters or AP citing either, reports a drone or missile strike on a merchant vessel inside the Bulgarian or Romanian Black Sea EEZ between 2026-10-08 and 2026-11-06; NO otherwise.
failure_condition: No merchant vessel is struck by a drone or missile inside the Bulgarian or Romanian Black Sea EEZ between 2026-10-08 and 2026-11-06.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range at its scheduled meeting of 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28, lifting the upper bound above 4.00 percent. Reference: 3.75 to 4.00 percent target range at seal on 2026-10-06.
resolution: YES if the FOMC statement issued 2026-10-28 for the meeting of 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28 sets an upper bound above 4.00 percent, per federalreserve.gov or FRED series DFEDTARU. Reference: 4.00 percent at seal.
failure_condition: The target range announced on 2026-10-28 has an upper bound of 4.00 percent or lower.

statement: The WTI Cushing spot crude price for 2026-12-01 is below 80.00 dollars per barrel. Reference: WTI 87.77 dollars per barrel in the packet market snapshot on 2026-10-06.
resolution: YES if FRED series DCOILWTICO shows a value below 80.00 for 2026-12-01; NO if 80.00 or higher. If no value posts for that date, use the nearest prior trading day. Reference: 87.77 on 2026-10-06.
failure_condition: The WTI Cushing spot price for 2026-12-01 is 80.00 dollars per barrel or higher.

statement: CISA adds CVE-2026-61500, the Rejetto HFS session forgery flaw that enables unauthenticated remote code execution, to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-10-07 and 2026-12-04.
resolution: YES if the CISA KEV catalog JSON feed lists CVE-2026-61500 with a dateAdded value from 2026-10-07 through 2026-12-04 inclusive; NO otherwise.
failure_condition: CISA does not add CVE-2026-61500 to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-10-07 and 2026-12-04.

statement: Democratic candidates win at least 218 of the 435 US House seats in the general election held on 2026-11-03, per AP race calls standing on 2026-12-02.
resolution: YES if AP race calls standing on 2026-12-02 credit Democratic candidates with at least 218 House seats from the 2026-11-03 election; NO if fewer than 218 are called for Democrats by then.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates win fewer than 218 of the 435 House seats contested on 2026-11-03.

statement: The US Army carries out the death sentence of Nidal Hasan, the convicted Fort Hood shooter, between 2026-10-07 and 2027-03-31.
resolution: YES if the Army or Pentagon confirms, or AP or Reuters reports, that Nidal Hasan was executed on a date between 2026-10-07 and 2027-03-31; NO otherwise.
failure_condition: Nidal Hasan is not executed between 2026-10-07 and 2027-03-31, whether because of a court stay, an Army postponement or any other cause.

statement: The German Federal Prosecutor General files an indictment against former BND president August Hanning between 2026-10-07 and 2027-03-31.
resolution: YES if a Federal Prosecutor General press release, or Reuters, AP or dpa, states that charges were filed against August Hanning at a German court between 2026-10-07 and 2027-03-31; NO otherwise.
failure_condition: No indictment against August Hanning is filed with a German court between 2026-10-07 and 2027-03-31.

statement: Kenya confirms at least one additional laboratory-confirmed Ebola case, beyond the fatal imported case announced on 2026-10-06, between 2026-10-07 and 2026-11-06.
resolution: YES if the Kenya Ministry of Health, or a WHO Disease Outbreak News or situation report, confirms a new laboratory-confirmed Ebola case in Kenya between 2026-10-07 and 2026-11-06; NO otherwise.
failure_condition: No Ebola case other than the index case announced on 2026-10-06 is laboratory-confirmed in Kenya between 2026-10-07 and 2026-11-06.

statement: The CDC cumulative count of confirmed 2026 US measles cases reaches at least 5,500 in a weekly update published between 2026-10-07 and 2026-12-02. Reference: about 3,880 cases at the start of October 2026.
resolution: YES if any CDC Measles Cases and Outbreaks weekly update published from 2026-10-07 through 2026-12-02 shows at least 5,500 confirmed 2026 US cases; NO otherwise. Reference: about 3,880 at start of October.
failure_condition: The CDC confirmed 2026 US measles count stays below 5,500 in every weekly update published from 2026-10-07 through 2026-12-02.
